items.titleEn: Rump Pepe called the increasing influence of women leaders a boost to economic and social development
items.summaryEn: According to the Director of the Office of Cultural Sports and Tourism, Romppe, the Chinese national team in Hong Kong won 11 gold medals and 54 medals at the recent successful Asian Games in Nagoya, about half of which were women athletes. In addition to the 41 medals won by women athletes, 23 were won by women, and 9 were won by mixed doubles, with women representing the majority. She said that women athletes in Hong Kong not only fought for the glory of Hong Kong but also inspired countless young people, especially young girls, to boldly pursue their dreams. items.title: 衞防中心促醫護人員主動提醒病人適時接種新冠疫苗 提供計劃資訊
items.summary: 衞生防護中心表示，根據有醫療組織的調查顯示，近四成受訪醫生不會主動提醒病人接種新冠疫苗。中心對此表示關注，敦促醫護人員主動提醒病人適時接種新冠疫苗的重要性，即使其診所不提供疫苗接種服務，亦可向病人提供有關政府新冠疫苗接種計劃的資訊，共同守護公眾健康。 中心說，就個別醫療組織表示有醫生沒有新冠疫苗儲備和關注新冠疫苗接種率低，及傳媒的相關查詢，中心作相關澄清。…
items.titleEn: The Centre for Prevention urged healthcare workers to provide information on the plan to remind patients to get the new coronavirus vaccine in due course
items.summaryEn: According to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), a survey conducted by health organizations shows that nearly 40% of doctors interviewed do not actively remind patients to get the new coronavirus vaccine. The Centre expressed concern about this and urged healthcare professionals to take a proactive role in reminding patients of the importance of timely vaccination, and to provide patients with information about the government's vaccination program to protect public health even if their clinics do not provide vaccination services. According to the Center, the healthcare organizations have said that doctors do not have a vaccine in stock and are concerned about low levels of vaccination, and the Center has clarified the issue in media inquiries. I'm not going to lie.

items.title: 灣仔前年一名工人從金屬梯墮下死亡 涉案物管公司被判罰款3萬元
items.summary: 灣仔前年發生一宗致命意外，一名工人懷疑從金屬梯墮下，其後死亡。涉案物業管理公司，今日在東區裁判法院被判罰款3萬元。 事發在前年7月3日，灣仔一幢住宅大廈，一名工人在檢查一個住宅單位廁所內的照明設施期間，懷疑從一把金屬梯墮下，該名工人頭部嚴重受傷，兩日後離世。涉案的​富城物業管理有限公司因違反《職業安全及健康條例》的規定，被勞工處檢控。 編輯：任順熙
items.titleEn: A worker who fell from a metal staircase and died last year was fined 30,000 yuan by the company involved in the case.
items.summaryEn: In the past year, a deadly accident in Bayou, where a worker was suspected of falling from a metal staircase, resulted in his death. A property management company involved in the case was sentenced today in the Eastern District Magistrate's Court to a $30,000 fine. On July 3, a worker in a residential building in Taiwan suspected of falling from a metal staircase while inspecting the lighting facilities in a bathroom of a residential unit with severe head injuries and died two days later. The company, which was involved in the case, is being prosecuted by the Department of Labor for violating the Occupational Safety and Health Act. Editor's note: This is a great book.

items.titleEn: Police arrested 22 people who were involved in the smuggling of illegal money to Port-au-Prince and spent three months laundering 150 million
items.summaryEn: Police have detected a cross-border money laundering group, arrested 22 people, and believe the group was involved in more than 200 fraud cases, estimating that the group cleared about 150 million yuan between August and October. Twenty-two people were arrested, including two local men, 19 inland men and one inland woman, on suspicion of money laundering and conspiracy to launder money. Police searched a hotel, a kitchen unit and a store disguised as a virtual currency exchange, yesterday and today. I'm not going to lie.

items.title: 26歲男子感染猴痘 潛伏期曾透過社交平台結識男子有高風險接觸

items.titleEn: A 26-year-old man who was infected with measles during his time in hiding has made contact with high-risk men through social media
items.summaryEn: A 26-year-old man confirmed that he had high-risk contacts with other men he had met via social media platforms in Hong Kong during his time in hiding, and the situation is currently stable. According to the Centre for the Prevention of Tuberculosis, the man was exposed to a rash and a fever that started on 1st of this month. He was admitted to the Australian General Hospital on Sunday and was placed under quarantine. After his clinical trial, he tested positive for the Zika virus. The Centre is continuing its epidemiological investigation into the case and will notify the World Health Organization about the incident. I'm not going to lie.

items.title: 香港國際警務學院開幕 目標每年培訓約千人
items.summary: 香港國際警務學院開幕，行政長官李家超致辭時說，培訓是學院的核心功能，同時亦鞏固香港作為「超級聯繫人」和「超級增值人」的角色。 他表示安全挑戰，例如網絡犯罪、金融詐騙等是跨地域，亦日益複雜，強大的國際聯繫對全球安全和繁榮至關重要。 警務處處長周一鳴說，學院目標每年培訓約1000名人員，當中包括約200名海外執法人員。 編輯：梁家奇
items.titleEn: Hong Kong International Police Academy opens with the goal of training about 1,000 people annually
items.summaryEn: In a speech at the opening of the Hong Kong International Police Academy, Chief Executive Lee Geun-hye said that training is the core function of the academy, while also strengthening Hong Kong's role as a "super connector" and "super value adder". He said that security challenges such as cybercrime, financial fraud and others are cross-regional, and that increasingly complex and strong international connections are essential for global security and prosperity. The police chief said Monday that the college's goal is to train about 1,000 staff per year, including about 200 law enforcement officers overseas. Editor's note: Liang Jian

items.titleEn: Nine people were arrested for smuggling frozen meat from Chinese-British streets to different markets and 140,000 yuan were seized by customs.
items.summaryEn: Customs detected a case of smuggling frozen meat and food, seized about 570 kg of frozen meat smuggled and 500 kg of smuggled food, with an estimated market value of about 140,000 yuan, and arrested nine people. The Coast Guard suspects illegal importation of frozen meat into Hong Kong from the sandy corners of British Street, then distributed to various street markets and homes, and on Tuesday took action to search three vehicles transporting frozen meat and food to fresh food stores and homes in the city, and to identify the suspected smuggling of frozen meats and food, including seafood, vegetables and pre-cooked foods. items.title: 立法會辯論北都專屬法例多名議員支持草案 明繼續二讀辯論
items.summary: 立法會晚上休會，明天早上續會，將繼續二讀辯論《北部都會區發展條例草案》。 多名議員發言支持條例草案。有議員相信，北都將會為香港帶來第二次黃金發展機遇，必須為北都制定一套專屬法律，釋放戰略潛力。 亦有議員說，專屬法例雖然賦予行政機關較大的酌情權和拆牆鬆綁的空間，但簡化程序不等於降低標準，賦權放寬亦不等同讓行政當局「黑箱作業」。…
items.titleEn: The legislative assembly debates the draft law, which has been supported by a majority of MPs in the North, and continues the second reading.
items.summaryEn: The legislative assembly is in session for the evening and will resume its session tomorrow morning to continue its second reading of the draft North Shore Urban Development Act. Many MPs voted in favour of the draft law. Some MPs believe that the North will provide Hong Kong with a second opportunity for gold development, and that a special set of laws must be enacted for the North to unlock its strategic potential. While private legislation gives the administration more discretion and space to undo the walls, the simplification process does not mean lowering standards, and the extension of powers does not mean allowing the administration to "work in a black box". items.titleEn: A video posted online of female students suspected of smoking e-cigarettes in the bathroom has been contacted by the school, according to the Education Department.
items.summaryEn: A video was posted online showing several female students wearing school uniforms taking photos of themselves in the bathroom, one of whom is suspected of holding and smoking e-cigarettes. According to the Guardian, the school is very concerned about the online circulation of a video about the students, and has promised to meet with their parents and follow up seriously. According to the school, it has been committed to developing good students' qualities and has established training and mentoring mechanisms to provide appropriate support and guidance to students.
